licenses: CodeGuard-generated synthetic claim; no source passage included
PSF License Version 2 (Python documentation); attribution/source link retained
split_method: Deterministic seed-42 group assignment by evidence chunk; grouped evidence/paired claims remain together. Approximate 70/15/15 is secondary to group integrity.

feature_descriptions.claim: Claim text generated from explicit, narrow Python documentation propositions.
feature_descriptions.evidence: Curated documentation passage associated with the claim; blank only where the existing pilot had no retrieved passage.
feature_descriptions.label: SUPPORT/CONTRADICT based on direct passage semantics; INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE means the supplied evidence does not establish the claim, not that the claim is false.
feature_descriptions.topic: Python topic associated with the source proposition.
feature_descriptions.data_origin: All examples are synthetic claim wording; source text/provenance is retained.

limitations: All 31 records are synthetic claim wording, not independent expert or human annotations.
No compatible public Python claim/evidence dataset was found and used; broad-domain fact-checking data were excluded for domain mismatch.
The dataset is small and based on a 12-passage curated Python documentation corpus; it is not representative of real AI explanations.
Contradictions are controlled polarity counterparts and may make labels lexically easy; labels reflect only the supplied passage.
Insufficient-evidence examples mean the provided passage does not establish the claim; this does not imply the claim is false.
Group integrity may produce split proportions differing from the nominal 70/15/15 target.
